comment: Bounding boxes (x1,y1,x2,y2) and centers (cx,cy) within the 240x240 aligned PNGs. bbox values match stack-chan/scripts/penguin-face-spec.json — PenguinLayout in firmware/main/stackchan/avatar/skins/penguin/penguin.h is derived from this.

sprites.comment: Each list is [variant_label, source_frame] or [variant_label, source_frame, [dx, dy]] to per-variant translate the bbox. dx/dy in source-pixel units (positive dx = crop region shifts right in source, which moves the rendered eye LEFT on the composite by dx px).

emotions.comment: Maps the 6 Emotion enum values to a (eye_variant, mouth_variant) tuple via variant LABEL (not index). extract_penguin_sprites.py resolves label → index by looking up in sprites lists above.
